title: GraphBit：基于图的非线形智能体编排框架
summary: GraphBit 是一种引擎编排的框架，将工作流显式定义为有向无环图（DAG），代理作为类型化函数运行，由 Rust 引擎控制路由、状态转换和工具调用。它支持并行分支、条件控制流和三层记忆架构，在 GAIA 基准测试中达到 67.6% 的准确率、零框架幻觉、最低延迟（11.9 ms）和最高吞吐量。
summary_en: GraphBit is an engine-orchestrated framework that defines workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), with agents operating as typed functions and a Rust-based engine governing routing, state transitions, and tool invocation. It supports parallel branches, conditional control flow, and a three-tier memory architecture, achieving 67.6% accuracy, zero framework-induced hallucinations, lowest latency (11.9 ms), and highest throughput on GAIA benchmarks.
